body:
Bills to collect and cash closing now share the demo’s Collect and close layout: existing permission-filtered route tabs, contextual guidance and actual totals. The compact collection table keeps owed and its action visible, retaining the existing financial breakdown in native expandable details. Financial scripts, backend rules, grants and migrations are unchanged.

This remains a DRAFT and is not full-demo acceptance or merge approval. The owner first requested preservation before handover, then resumed already-started work and delegated technical decisions. Under that delegation, the two previously proposed BIL23 presentation-test replacements were independently reviewed and applied. The decision record explicitly distinguishes delegation from a direct owner answer. All financial/date/review-required/read-only checks are preserved.

Validation:98/98 scoped frontend tests pass; reviewer independently reran9/9 BIL23/new-frame tests. Runtime source is unchanged from the reviewed four-file packet. Production build, scoped lint/format/diff checks and initial full typecheck passed. Twelve synthetic populated/read-only390/1440 light/dark states, expanded financial details, real overdue filter and cash-count validation refusal were checked; independent design review found no new scoped blocker. Latest remote CI remains a separate release gate.

Remaining full-demo work includes search/age-filter projections, remaining Billing groups, cash-history composition and complete interaction/state parity. Existing header/pagination target-size debt remains. No next-slice implementation is included. Earlier restyle draft1143 overlaps CashClosings.vue and must be reconciled deliberately before merging.

Evidence: docs/teams/billing/BILLING-DEMO-COLLECTIONS-DECISION-2026-11-26.md; local /workspace/kpone-validation/billing-demo-initial/REVIEW.md, INDEPENDENT-REVIEW.md, frontend-delegated.log, browser-results.json and manifest-delegated.json.
